text:
## Template 1: Large Withdrawal Alert  
**Trigger:** Withdrawal >£1,000 from mobile/ATM  
```
FirstUK: Large withdrawal of £[amount] from your account [last 4
digits]. If not you, call 0800-555-2265 immediately. Ref: [code]
```  
*Character count: ~120*

raw_entities.name: Large Withdrawal Alert
raw_entities.description: An SMS alert template triggered when a customer attempts a withdrawal exceeding £1,000 via mobile or ATM channels. The message notifies the customer of the transaction amount and account identifier, and instructs them to contact the fraud hotline immediately if the transaction was unauthorised.
context: FirstUK: Large withdrawal of £[amount] from your account [last 4 digits]. If not you, call 0800-555-2265 immediately. Ref: [code]

raw_entities.description: A dynamic placeholder for a unique transaction reference code included in the alert message to enable the customer and fraud team to track and reference the specific transaction.

raw_entities.description: A fraud detection alert triggered automatically when a withdrawal transaction exceeds £1,000 through mobile or ATM channels. The alert prompts immediate customer verification and provides a fraud hotline contact for unauthorised transaction reporting.
